CALENDAR & PRICING — FOLIO NO. 12

The year, priced to its mood.

Each night is a decision — what to charge, who to welcome, when to rest the rooms. Set the rhythm once, the calendar carries it across every channel you sync to.

CHAPTER TWO

Seasons declared, then honoured.

Rather than fields with single nights, define four broad seasons and let them carry the pricing forward. Override only where the calendar — an exhibition opening, a regional holiday, the long quiet of February — calls for it.

CHAPTER THREE

Distributed, but never duplicated.

When you publish, the calendar pushes outward in three minutes — to the direct booking engine, to Airbnb, to the partner channels you've consented to. Sync conflicts pause for review; no double bookings, no overlap.
